details.description: Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS is Google's flagship creative text-to-speech model, released September 22, 2026 and engineered for studio-grade voice fidelity, nuanced acting, authentic regional accents, and long-form multi-turn stability, per its Gemini API model page and the Gemini API changelog. It converts text, plus inline style directions and vocal-event tags, into spoken audio across 130 languages, supporting single- and multi-speaker generation, Voice design for persistent custom vocal personas, and Voice replication with consent verification. As of 2026-09-24, Google's Gemini API models page lists it as a current 'New Stable' Flash-tier TTS model alongside the cost-efficient Gemini 3.8 Flash-Lite TTS.
advantages: Google's Gemini API changelog describes it as a flagship creative TTS model engineered for studio-grade voice fidelity, nuanced acting, regional dialects, and long-form multi-turn stability.
Supports 130 languages, per Google's Gemini API speech-generation guide.
Supports Voice design, creating persistent custom vocal personas from text prompts, and Voice replication with consent verification, per Google's Gemini API changelog.
Ships with 30 prebuilt studio voices plus access to an Extended Voice Library of 150+ prebuilt and custom voices, per Google's Gemini API speech-generation guide and changelog.
Supports single- and multi-speaker generation (up to two speakers per request) with streaming audio output, per Google's Gemini API speech-generation guide.
Supports Batch API access for high-volume speech generation, per its Gemini API model page.
disadvantages: Accepts text input only, with no audio, image or video input, per its Gemini API model page.
Does not support the Live API for real-time conversation, function calling, code execution, or thinking, per its Gemini API model page.
use_cases: Studio-grade narration and voice acting for podcasts, audiobooks and other long-form content
Complex multi-speaker dialogue requiring nuanced acting and regional accents
Creating persistent custom vocal personas through Voice design
Personalized audio through Voice replication with consent verification

notes: Catalog facts (8,192 input / 16,384 output tokens, text input -> audio output, no deprecation date) match the Gemini API model page exactly. Released September 22, 2026 per the API changelog and deprecations page; no shutdown date is announced. No accuracy-style benchmark score for this exact model was found on any Google page, so evaluations is left empty. The 130-language count is stated by Google but no full per-language list was found, so languages is left empty rather than guessed. Voice-count figures differ slightly across pages (30 prebuilt studio voices per the speech-generation guide vs. "150+ prebuilt and custom voices" in the Extended Voice Library per the changelog); both are reported as separate, attributed claims rather than reconciled into one number.
